verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs say webhooks give real-time updates for subscription events, used to feed Recurly Engage (recurly-docs-31), and that credit invoices trigger webhook notifications (recurly-docs-22). So Recurly does emit lifecycle webhooks, but the pack does not show coverage of each named state change or any reliability guarantees. Missing for 10: an explicit event catalog covering renewal, upgrade/downgrade, payment failure and cancellation; delivery reliability (retries, ordering, signatures/verification, replay); dedicated first-party webhook docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
